//: WHAT THIS FILE IS — This is a configuration file, not a program (Windows version). It is where you type in all the inputs needed to run forward_analysis.py (the CRISIS forward-analysis source code) from the terminal / command line, as an alternative to using the CRISIS GUI. As set up below, this file stays in the CRISIS_Code folder next to forward_analysis.py, and the path fields point out to a separate input-data folder (e.g. a sibling folder like ../Example 1) — adjust those paths if you keep the input data and this file together in the same folder instead. Fill in the values below, save the file, then from within CRISIS_Code run: python forward_analysis.py config_forward_windows.json

PROJECT DETAILS — project_title (always fill in). analyst_name (optional, leave empty if not needed). project_date (optional, leave empty if not needed). site_location (optional, leave empty if not needed). notes (optional, leave empty if not needed).

OUTPUT — output_dir: path (relative or absolute) to the folder where outputs should be saved, e.g. "../Example 1" (always fill in). A subfolder {project_title}_Outputs is created automatically inside. Coordinate_Reference_System: EPSG code of your study area projection (always fill in).

TRIGGERING — Triggering_Indicator: 1 = rainfall only, 2 = rainfall + seismic (always fill in). Seismic_displacement_model: 1 = Jibson, 2 = Rathje rigid, 3 = Rathje flexible, 4 = Bray & Macedo (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2, otherwise leave as null). Rathje_method: 1 = PGAM, 2 = PGAV (fill in only if Seismic_displacement_model = 2 or 3, otherwise leave as null).

TOPOGRAPHY — dem_file: path (relative or absolute) to the DEM file, including the folder it's in — either an HDF5 (.h5) file, e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/DEM.h5", or a GeoTIFF (.tif/.tiff), e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/DEM.tif" (always fill in). Cell_size: DEM resolution in meters (always fill in). xmin: easting of the center of the lower-left DEM cell in meters (always fill in). ymin: northing of the center of the lower-left DEM cell in meters (always fill in). IMPORTANT: if dem_file is a GeoTIFF, Cell_size/xmin/ymin below are auto-derived from it and will silently override whatever you enter here — they only take effect for an HDF5 DEM. A GeoTIFF must be in a projected CRS in meters (not geographic/degrees) or it will be rejected with an error.

SEISMIC RASTERS — pga_file: path (relative or absolute) to the PGA raster file, e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/PGA.h5" (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2, otherwise leave empty). pgv_file: path (relative or absolute) to the PGV raster file, e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/PGV.h5" (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2 AND Rathje_method = 2 or Seismic_displacement_model = 4, otherwise leave empty).

FAULT PLANE CORNERS — Four corners of the fault plane, X/Y = easting/northing (m), Z = depth positive downward (m). fault_X1/Y1/Z1 (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2 AND Seismic_displacement_model = 3 or 4, otherwise leave as null). Same condition applies to fault_X2/Y2/Z2, fault_X3/Y3/Z3, fault_X4/Y4/Z4.

SCALAR INPUTS — Gamma: unit weight of soil in kN/m3 (always fill in). z_min: minimum depth from the surface — 0 if exactly at the surface, or the center of the uppermost layer; must match the hydrological model's discretization if using pore pressure files, otherwise (constant Ru) up to you (always fill in). z_max: deepest depth you want to study — bottom edge or center of the last layer; same consistency rule as z_min (always fill in). Depth_points: number of subsurface depth layers discretizing z_min to z_max; must match the hydrological model's files if used, but still required with constant Ru — one layer means every failure occurs at exactly the same depth (always fill in). time_points: number of time steps (always fill in). Min_LD_area: minimum modeled landslide area in m2 (always fill in). top_or_bottom_indicator: 0 = triggering the shallowest failure depth, 1 = triggering the deepest failure (always fill in).

SEISMIC SCALARS — Earthquake_time_point: integer index of the time step at which the earthquake occurs, between 0 (first time step) and time_points-1 (last time step) (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2, otherwise leave as null). Seismic_displacement_threshold: Newmark displacement threshold for failure in cm (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2, otherwise leave as null). M: moment magnitude (fill in only if Triggering_Indicator = 2, otherwise leave as null). Ts: sliding-mass natural period in seconds (fill in only if Seismic_displacement_model = 3 or 4, otherwise leave as null).

HYDROLOGY — Hydrological_model_indicator: 0 = constant Ru, 1 = pore pressure files (always fill in). hydro_files_dir: path (relative or absolute) to the folder containing the Pressure_head_T{t}Z{d+1}.h5 files, e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs" (fill in only if Hydrological_model_indicator = 1, otherwise leave empty). Ru: pore pressure ratio, from 0 (dry) up to Ru_max = gamma_water/gamma — NOT 1; pressure head at depth z is Ru*gamma*z/gamma_water, the same at every cell at that depth and constant over time (fill in only if Hydrological_model_indicator = 0, otherwise leave as null).

VOLUMETRIC WATER CONTENT — Strength_variation_with_theta: 0 = Bishop coefficient = 1 (fully saturated), 1 = varies with saturation (always fill in). theta_files_dir: path (relative or absolute) to the folder containing the Theta_T{t}Z{d+1}.h5 files, e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs" (fill in only if Strength_variation_with_theta = 1, otherwise leave empty). Theta_s: saturated volumetric water content (fill in only if Strength_variation_with_theta = 1, otherwise leave as null). Theta_r: residual volumetric water content (fill in only if Strength_variation_with_theta = 1, otherwise leave as null).

SHEAR STRENGTH — Strength_status: 0 = spatially uniform c and Phi, 1 = spatially variable 3D arrays (always fill in). c: cohesion in kPa (fill in only if Strength_status = 0, otherwise leave as null). Phi: friction angle in degrees (fill in only if Strength_status = 0, otherwise leave as null). cohesion_3d_file: path (relative or absolute) to the HDF5 array file of shape (rows, cols, Depth_points), e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/Cohesion_3D.h5" (fill in only if Strength_status = 1, otherwise leave empty). phi_3d_file: path (relative or absolute) to the HDF5 array file of shape (rows, cols, Depth_points), e.g. "../Example 1/Example 1 Inputs/Phi_3D.h5" (fill in only if Strength_status = 1, otherwise leave empty).
